name: cascade-product
description: Manage evidence-bound product discovery, definition, validation, delivery handoff, and learning while delegating persona, market, prompt, simulation, and evaluation mechanics to their owning Cascade plugins.

interface.longDescription: Turn product opportunities into traceable decisions, product definitions, journeys, requirements, priorities, experiments, delivery handoffs, and learning loops while preserving market evidence, persona provenance, simulation limits, and independent evaluation.
defaultPrompt: Find this product initiative's current state and next gate.
Turn this evidence into a traceable product definition.
Validate this product hypothesis with the right evidence.
